blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY, Philippines — The city council urged the City Health Services Office (CHSO) to replace the general term “Igorot” with specific ethnolinguistic classifications in its official forms and patient records to ensure more accurate representation of indigenous peoples in the Cordillera. According to the council, the request was made through Resolution No. 834-2026, which adopted Resolution No. 06-2026 of the Office of Indigenous Peoples Mandatory Representative (IPMR) Maximo Edwin Jr. The resolution recommends removing “Igorot” as a general ethnolinguistic category in CHSO forms, databases and patient records and replacing it with specific classifications recognized by the National Commission on Indigenous […]...
